_comment: Path and hash constants for controlled_thyme_success_flash.ps1. Kept in a separate UTF-8 JSON file because the package directory name contains CJK characters and Windows PowerShell 5.1 mis-decodes CJK literals inside .ps1 files read as ANSI. Do not edit the hashes without re-verifying them read-only against the untouched package.
verificationNote: Read-only SHA256 of the untouched community package. super.img is a raw (non-sparse) LpMetadata image with a non-AOSP metadata layout; see reports/m00_madrid_intake_20261005/SUCCESS_PORT_DONOR_IDENTITY.md section 4.
